# Starry Skies of Remembrance
## Scripture
"I will remember my covenant between me and you and all living creatures of every kind. Never again will the waters become a flood to destroy all life." - Genesis 9:15

## Reflection
As we gaze up at the starry skies, we are reminded of God's faithfulness and covenant-making nature. The story of Noah's Ark and the resulting rainbow covenant serves as a beautiful illustration of God's promise to never again destroy the earth with a flood. This divine promise is a testament to God's sovereignty over creation and His desire to be in relationship with us. Just as the stars twinkle in the night sky, God's promises shine brightly, guiding us through life's journey.

## Prayer
Dear Heavenly Father, as we marvel at the vast expanse of Your creation, we are reminded of Your faithfulness and promise-keeping nature. Help us to recall Your covenant with us, and may it bring us comfort and peace in times of uncertainty. Just as the stars remain constant in the night sky, may Your presence be a steady guiding force in our lives. We pray that You would illuminate our path, and that we would trust in Your good plans for us. Amen.
